CustomField.description: How a lookup field displays on the form. Standard is the normal lookup. Form Component shows the referenced record inline through a nested form component, chosen in the Reference Form Component and Alternative Field settings. Start New Form and View/Edit Form Submission show the full form in place of the lookup, and are offered only when the lookup points at a Form Template or a Form Submission. Start New Form opens the template with the current record as its source, so source mappings and prefill apply. A form is never shown inside itself: nothing renders when the lookup points back at the record it sits on. Record Picker shows a searchable picker with filters, set in Record Picker Settings, for lookups to a single object.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Overrides how a lookup field displays on the form. Form Component renders the referenced record inline through a nested form. Start New Form and View/Edit Form Submission render the full form runtime in place of the lookup, and appear only when the lookup points at a Form Template or a Form Submission. Record Picker adds filters and extra display and search fields, for lookups that point at one object.
